Jon (Product): Heads up — quick design review for a new "onboarding ribbon" that sits flush under the global header on first-run. Prototype: https://img.mock/onboard-ribbon-2180.png. Need copy variant, keyboard behavior, and dismiss rules. Can we get quick takes?

Ana (Design): Love the ribbon for low friction. Copy options: `Finish setup`, `Add a sample app`, `Quickstart walkthrough`. My vote: `Add a sample app` — explicit CTA. Also propose a subtle progress indicator (3 dots) and compact labels under thumbnails.

Samir (A11y): A11y quick list: 1) ribbon should be `role="region"` with `aria-labelledby` pointing to the heading. 2) Ensure the first tabbable control is the `Skip setup` link so keyboard users can opt out quickly. 3) Colors: CTA needs 4.5:1 contrast; secondary links 3:1 minimum.

Mira (Frontend): Keyboard: ribbon should accept arrow keys to move between thumbnails when the ribbon has focus; Enter activates the focused thumbnail action. We'll scope key handlers to the ribbon container only. For focus management, if the ribbon auto-appears we should not steal focus — instead insert a visible focus outline on hover/tab enter.

Theo (Research): From last tests, explicit verbs perform better. `Add a sample app` had higher clarity than `Finish setup`. Also users prefer the ribbon to auto-hide after they create a project. Recommendation: hide permanently on `project_created`, hide for 14 days on dismiss.

Ana (Design): Microcopy nuance: button label could include a micro-label like `Add a sample app — recommended` but that's long. Maybe show `Recommended` pill next to top sample instead. Visual tweak: tighten thumbnail spacing, increase tap target to 44px.

Samir (A11y): Additional nit: thumbnails must have descriptive `alt` text (eg `Alt="Notes sample app: serverless backend"`) and cards must not rely on color alone for selected state. Also ensure focus-visible rings are not removed in CSS.

Mira (Frontend): I'll implement `aria-roledescription="onboarding ribbon"`, `role="region"`, add analytics events `ribbon_shown`, `ribbon_cta_click`, `ribbon_dismiss`, and include `variant` in payload. Also will respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

CI-Bot: Staging build deployed (#4988) with ribbon markup and variant A copy (`Add a sample app`).

Jon (Product): Thanks all — please leave final PR comments by EOD. If Samir signs off, we'll roll to 8% canary tomorrow. :rocket:
